outputs.explanation: Panel a shows schematic/representative example images illustrating image cropping, rotation and resizing; no quantitative or replicated data is presented.
Panel b illustrates image spacing conventions using representative example images; no quantification or replication is involved.
Panel c shows a representative image and inset to illustrate magnification/zoom presentation; no replicated quantitative data shown.
Panel d shows representative images at different brightness/contrast settings to illustrate an editing concept, not replicated experimental data.
Panel e shows representative example images illustrating channel annotation practices; no replicated quantitative data.
Panel f shows representative images demonstrating grayscale versus color channel display; no replication data involved.
Panel g shows representative example images with calibration scales illustrating intensity/pseudocolor scale practices; no replicated quantitative data or statistics are presented.
